items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He gave me the words to Don’t Get Scared, and there were no words to my solo, the Lars Gullin baritone saxophone solo.

ctx.x: He gave me the words to Don’t Get Scared, and there were no words to my solo, the Lars Gullin baritone saxophone solo. I said, “Where are the words to Lars Gullin’s part?” He said, “You write them yourself.” I never knew an artist to do that.
Just give you the liberty of . . .
